# GROUP A: a cipher sign shaped like a crossed "4": a looped head over a horizontal bar with a long straight descender through it, usually followed by a small "3"-like hook on the right.
# GROUP B: a cipher sign made of a closed figure-8 or double loop sitting on a long descender stroke, like a "φ" with a loop on top.
# GROUP C: the ordinary cursive minuscule "a": a closed round bowl with a short right-hand stem and no descender.
# GROUP D: the ordinary cursive minuscule "o": a single closed round bowl with no stem.
